title: Salt and Veil
author: Bram Underhill
blurb: Mirabel Joubert, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
